title: Re-configuring the Michelson Interferometer for Multi-path Instrumentation
content: This article proposes a reconfiguration of the Michelson interferometer which introduces additional arrays of beam splitters, mirrors and detectors. It is expected to yield multiple interference patterns detectable by multiple detectors, enabling comparative analysis of the interference patterns. The number of interference patterns that can be generated is not limited but depends on the intensity of the beams and the number of available beam splitters required for certain experimental and Instrumentation purpose. The interference of multiple beams may improve sensitivity and detection for instrumentation purposes.
